notes.title: Store page translated to different languages
notes.content:
To make the store page of the game more accessible to players all around the world, we translated the page to the following languages:


 French
 Italian
 German
 Spanish
 Japanese
 Russian
 Simplified Chinese

notes.title: Patch 1.03 released
notes.content:
The latest patch updates the game to version 1.03.

Fixes:

 decreased the damage output of the beam laser weapon,
 fixed the Level 5 Bonus Mission achievement, which failed to unlock upon completion.

notes.title: Patch 1.02 released
notes.content:
This patch brings up the game to version 1.02. 

Changes:

 Can't fire the beam laser weapon continuously anymore by rapidly pressing the primary attack button.
 Slightly decreased the overheat rate of the beam laser, and increased its damage.
 Upgrading a weapon automatically installs it on the ship.
 Attack drones cover a bigger area and move faster around the ship.
 Fixed a bug which caused units to have negative scores.

notes.title: Patch: Hotfix version 1.01 released
notes.content:
Why would the launch of a game go smoothly - asks every game developer ever?

I noticed a small error which resulted in some of the text not showing correctly in the Level Data menu. I released a quick fix, so after updating the game, you shouldn't encounter this error any more. 

I apologise for the inconvenience this caused.
